info.title: bmo-agency
info.description: The agency's agents, their sessions, turns and runs, the executions on the agent host, the co-worker pool and places, providers, models, tiers and roads, accounts and rest, companions and workers, worker assignments, and the jobs it runs. A job is an item run on a worker for the harness that holds the item: the harness asks for a worker with POST /assignments, then hands the item's content and its lease over with POST /jobs. The run's progress, questions and outcome are its own events and fields, which the harness reads and carries into the job service, where it reports and closes the item; words appended to the item reach the run as the harness sends them into the job's session. As a job ends, the agency gives its lease back to the job service and queues its report in the room through the receiver's instruction route. Everything it remembers or runs on is an upstream it reaches through what that upstream publishes. It serves only its own nouns: a run with a fixed prompt is an ordinary session started with POST /sessions and the run's prompt document, and that session calls the upstreams it needs through their own MCP servers; no route or tool of the agency forwards to them. It calls no downstream; gate and receiver register at its hook points. It stays one service.

x-harness.entry: A harness holding an item asks for a worker with agency_assign_worker, hands the item and its lease over with agency_run_job, and reads the job's progress and outcome from the job's events and fields.

x-tools.name: file_item
x-tools.description: File an item in the job service: the room it was asked in and whether the owner asked for it are the turn's, which the agency reads; an item the owner asked for himself opens at once, any other waits as a draft for his approval.

x-tools.name: stop_job
x-tools.description: Stop a running job on the owner's word, by its job id or by its item, with a short reason that becomes the job's report: only a turn whose every message is the owner's stops one. The job's turn is cut short first, and the answer is the job once its turn has ended, stopped; a turn still going after the wait is refused stop-pending, and the job ends stopped when it does.

x-tools.name: assign_worker
x-tools.description: Assign a worker to an item for the harness holding it: the agency picks the worker from the item's content and the assignee it names, and holds it until the job starts or the hold runs out.

x-tools.name: run_job
x-tools.description: Run an item on its assigned worker: the harness hands over the item's content and the lease it holds, and the agency launches the worker's session on it. The agency calls nothing of the job service.

x-tools.name: run_research
x-tools.description: Send a web research out on a research key: a search at a depth, or a browse. A run may be asked on a named model, as Claude Code's /model names it, a gateway member among them, and on a named provider; it is refused where nothing that carries the research line lists that model or can answer on it now. Answered at once with the run and the road it went out on; its result is queued for the room as the run ends.
